name: Elastic Slider
description: A slider that thickens under the pointer and, if you pull past either end, stretches like a rubber band and springs back.
interactionNotes: Drag or click on the track; the track thickens under your finger and, if you pull past either end, it stretches and then springs back. In right-to-left the track fills from the **right** and the arrow keys are mirrored too (left = more); in vertical mode it fills from the bottom. The mouse wheel (when `wheel` is on) and the Home/End keys can change the value as well.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Omit it for the value to be internal.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when it is not controlled.

props.name: startingValue
props.description: Lowest value of the range.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Highest value of the range.

props.name: isStepped
props.description: The value snaps to the `stepSize` grid.

props.name: stepSize
props.description: Size of each step when `isStepped` is on.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every value change.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: End of a drag, key, or wheel — once.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Track direction; vertical fills from the bottom.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon of the low end. It is logical: it sits on the left in LTR and on the right in RTL. `null` hides it.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Icon of the high end. On the right in LTR and on the left in RTL. `null` hides it.

props.name: iconPlacement
props.description: Outside the track or inside it. For inside, the thickness should be around 40px or the icons get clipped.

props.name: valuePosition
props.description: Where the number goes: above the track, in a moving bubble, inside the track, or nowhere.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the number and `aria-valuetext`; by default Persian digits via `Intl.NumberFormat('fa-IR')`.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Dots on the track: every step, every tenth, or explicit values.

props.name: thumb
props.description: Round handle at the head of the fill.

props.name: fillFrom
props.description: The value the fill grows from; the middle of the range means a two-sided fill.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Track thickness at rest, in pixels.

props.name: activeThickness
props.description: Track thickness on hover, focus, or drag.

props.name: radius
props.description: Track corner radius; omit it for the track to be fully round.

props.name: restOpacity
props.description: Brightness at rest; it reaches 1 when active.

props.name: growOnHover
props.description: Hover also activates the track; off means press/focus only.

props.name: maxStretch
props.description: Maximum stretch past either end, in pixels; zero turns it off.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much the return spring wobbles, 0 to 0.95.

props.name: jumpToClick
props.description: A click on the track puts the value right there; off means it drags from the current value.

props.name: wheel
props.description: Let the mouse wheel change the value (it captures scrolling over the track).

props.name: trackColor
props.description: Color of the empty groove.

props.name: rangeColor
props.description: Color of the fill; in the demo the default is the theme's mono and the variants add an accent.

props.name: iconColor
props.description: Color of the icons outside the track.

props.name: contentColor
props.description: Color of the number/icon/tick over the empty groove.

props.name: fillContentColor
props.description: Color of the content over the fill; `auto` picks opaque ink from the brightness of the fill color.

props.name: thumbColor
props.description: Handle color.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns interaction off and dims the whole slider.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the slider.

props.name: dir
props.description: Provide the direction manually; by default it is read from the computed `direction`.

props.name: ref
props.description: Imperative handle with `bump(side)` — stretches the track past one end and springs it back without changing the value; for preview drivers and storytelling.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style; it is applied after the color variables.

tips: In right-to-left the track fills from the right; the left key means 'more'. The same convention holds in `wake-slider`.
For a two-sided fill (like camera exposure), set `fillFrom` to the middle of the range and turn `thumb` on.
For an inside icon, take `thickness` to around 40px; otherwise the icons get clipped in a thin track.
With `ticks={[0]}` you show only the zero dot; a numeric `ticks` brings in every step.
If the mouse wheel should scroll the page, leave `wheel` off (the default).
